# cloudaxion_billing_accounts (Data Source)

Billing accounts on the CloudAxion account.

Billing is otherwise out of scope for this provider, but nearly every create call requires a `billing_account_id`, so this read-only lookup exists to find it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Nearly every create call needs a billing account id.
data "cloudaxion_billing_accounts" "all" {}

output "default_billing_account" {
  value = data.cloudaxion_billing_accounts.all.default_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes List) Available billing accounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))
- `default_id` (Number) Identifier of the account marked as default.

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Billing account identifier.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default account.
- `name` (String) Account name, when the API reports one.
